title: Bug 654042: [DocumentReporting] Exporting Word layout themes uses the wrong file extension
summary: Word theme layouts are now exported with the dotx file extension instead of docx. GetFileExtension in Report Layouts Impl. now handles Word layout subtypes, and the PR adds the missing tests for the artifact export functions.
key_points: GetFileExtension in codeunit 9660 now handles Word layout subtypes
Theme layouts are exported as dotx instead of docx
Adds tests for the layout export functions in the composite layout and report layout test codeunits
Adds sample docx, xlsx and dotx layout files and extends the test report
